question:
What does the `continue` statement do in the following code?

```python
for i in range(5):
    if i == 3:
        continue
    print(i)
```

options.A: Terminates the loop when i equals 3
options.B: Skips the rest of the loop body when i equals 3 and continues with the next iteration
options.C: Pauses the loop when i equals 3
options.D: Restarts the loop when i equals 3
